# get_route

## Purpose

Read one route from its ID: its ratings, each labelled with its grading system, its elevation data and practical facts, its summary, description and other free-text sections, the areas it belongs to, and the books, waypoints, sibling routes, articles and recent outings associated with it. Use it whenever an answer depends on a route's rating, elevation or description, and cite the camptocamp.org URL it prints.

| `id`      | integer | yes      |         | > 0         |
| `lang`    | string  | no       |         |             |

- `id`: Route ID from Camptocamp.
- `lang`: Language of titles and texts, one of: fr, en, de, it, es, ca, eu, sl, zh (default fr). Values: `fr`, `en`, `de`, `it`, `es`, `ca`, `eu`, `sl`, `zh`
